relationships.subject: Phyllanthus niruri extract
relationships.evidence_quote: After the treatment, MMP-9 levels were significantly lower in the PN 196 group (p = 0.021) and PN 392 group (p = 0.012) compared to the negative control group.

key_findings: P. niruri lowered serum IL-1β, MDA and MMP-9 in endometriotic rats
